question: As of May 2020, which of the following groups is headed by Yusuff Ali MA?
solution:
The correct answer is __**LuLu Group.**__** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of May 2020, **LuLu Group** is headed by **Yusuff Ali MA.**
 
• The UAE__-based Lulu group would set up a food processing centre in Srinagar for sourcing a wide range of Agri products from Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• An MoU was signed between Lulu group and Fruit Master Agro Fresh Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• It has been signed for the supply of apple and other fruits for the supermarkets of Lulu group across the Gulf Countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• UAE-based Lulu Group has invested Rs 3,500 crore in Tamil Nadu as announced on 28 March 2022.
 
• It will set up shopping malls, hypermarkets and food processing and logistic centre in the state.
 
• An MoU was signed between Tamil Nadu Industrial Guidance and Export Promotion Bureau Pooja Kulkarni and Lulu group.
